lines.text: I'm dog tired after that long hike.

data.define: Used when you are so tired you can barely move.

example.text: I'm dog tired after that long hike.

misuse.text: Don't call your pet 'dog tired' literally.

data.l1_hook: كانت تلك النزهة تبدو بلا نهاية!
data.l1_ex: أنا "dog tired" بعد تلك النزهة السيرية الطويلة.

native.tip: “dog tired” = متعب جدًا. مثال: “I'm dog tired after that long hike.”
